segmentos.texto: I ran out of gas on an empty highway in the Nevada desert. Then I looked in my rearview mirror.
What the tow truck driver told me next still keeps me up at night. The full story is on our channel.

estilo: Cinematic still photograph, vertical 9:16 composition, 35mm film, night, muted desaturated colors, low contrast, cold tones, subtle film grain, realistic, American Southwest desert, no readable text, no logos, no watermark.

planos.prompt: A small compact car stopped alone on the shoulder of an empty desert highway at night, hazard lights glowing orange, the road vanishing into darkness, huge starry sky above.
A car's rearview mirror at night, close up, reflecting far behind the car the vague thin figure of a person standing at the edge of red taillight glow, unsettling.
A thin older woman with long gray hair and a hiking backpack, no coat, standing very still on the gravel shoulder of a desert highway at night, lit only by red taillight glow, face in shadow.
Close up of a thin older hand gripping and pulling the rear door handle of a car at night, red light, tense.
From inside the dark back seat of a car: a gray-haired figure bending down outside to peer through the rear side window, face obscured by reflections, the back seat empty.
Through a car's passenger window at night: a thin older woman with long gray hair leaning close to the glass, face half lit red, a calm unsettling smile, one knuckle against the glass.
An empty car passenger window at night, nothing outside but black desert and stars, no one there.
A tow truck with amber lights on a dark desert highway seen from far away, tiny under an enormous starry sky.
